job.job_description:
Research on various legal issues pertaining to client.
General Understanding of Global Regulatory Schemes.
Ability to do regulatory mapping and create compliance checklists.
Good with Compliance principles, theories, and concepts.
Assist in performance of risk assessment of business operations and processes.
Comprehensive compliance management with assigned client organization through series of activities to comply with all applicable regulations and statutes.
Develops solutions to a variety of complex problems of significant scope and complexity.
Leads Compliance related projects, identifies and manages internal/external resources and agency relationships.
To identify accountabilities for local/regional compliance program and consulting staff.
Performing routine and non activities utilizing various compliance tools, databases and software applications.
Performs complex analysis to identify potential compliance issues and areas of compliance requirements.
Good in analyzing laws and regulations.
Uploading and review of legal documents.
Analytical understanding and interpretation of client problems and their resolution.
Qualification Skills required
L.LB / BA.LLB / LLM / Company Secretary / Chartered Accountant
Excellent critical and legal reasoning skills.
Excellent command on English, written and verbal
Very strong focus on attention to detail.
Should be able to effectively communicate with the internal team and external clients
Team player with strong inter-personal skill.
